integrity: The proof is self-contained. The finite breadth-first-search check is only a sanity check and is not used as evidence for the infinite theorem. Literature comparisons distinguish pure necessitation from normal modal logic.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to positive reduction exponents and the one-variable iterated-box implication fragment; it does not classify arbitrary formulas or zero-exponent reductions. Originality is supported by targeted source and semantic-index searches, not by an exhaustive theorem database.
title: Reachability normal form for multiple modal reductions in pure necessitation
